answer: Each epoch an opal lighthouse flashes at a random minute and each claim needs its opal stamp, unprecomputable, so no clone can be filed ahead. Payout crosses a jetty with one berth per funding trail per tide, so extra clones queue a full tide each. Each claim drops a ferrous anchor, a bond whose weight doubles per anchor on the same trail, and anchors from one trail are chained, so one proven fake drags the whole chain down and burns every bond on it. A fleet of n pays n stamps, n tides and doubling anchors for one share while one honest agent files once, anchors once, keeps the catch.
